docs.title: About
docs.text: I am a geospatial analyst with a keen interest in understanding the complex relationships between people, places, and the environment. In my previous work, I managed large geospatial datasets and conducted critical analyses of India's high-altitude ecosystems. I use GIS, remote sensing, Python, and R to explore environmental patterns, investigate geographical questions, and uncover stories hidden within spatial data. I am particularly drawn to understanding landscapes, river systems, terrain, and glaciers. For me, every map is an opportunity to ask questions about a place and encourage space-based thinking in people, which I believe is an essential first step in resolving any issue.

docs.title: Research Assistant (Geospatial Analyst and Data Manager) — Nature Conservation Foundation
docs.text:
2023 – 2025

  • Managed spatial datasets for the High Altitude Program.
  • Supported the program's cartographic needs.
  • Integrated technology into conservation workflows.

docs.title: Project Intern — Nature Conservation Foundation
docs.text:
2023

  • Processed camera trap-based distance sampling data for blue sheep in the High Himalayas.
  • Assisted the field team with data collection and other field activities.

docs.title: Research Coordinator — Eco-Volunteers India
docs.text:
2021 – 2022

  • Supported the Forest Department with snare removal, crowd management during festivals, and forest fire-fighting.
  • Assisted in installing solar bore-wells to restore wildlife water sources.
  • Conducted community awareness programs.

docs.title: Research Intern — Nature Conservation Foundation
docs.text:
2020 – 2021

  • Worked with the Holématthi team on a study of leopard ecology.
  • Set up and monitored camera traps in the field, then collected, organized, sorted and analyzed the data.
  • Organized community events supporting the sale of locally made products from forest fringe villages.
